verdict.rationale: Maritime's quickstart documents a free plan that includes 3 agents with no card required. Its docs also describe self-serve onboarding: install the CLI via npm, mint keys yourself with `maritime keys create`, and deploy your first agent in under 5 minutes. Nothing in the evidence involves a sales conversation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the free-tier signup flow, and documentation of the free plan's limits beyond the agent count (e.g., included LLM credits or usage caps).

support.subject: As a developer, I can start building with a free tier or included credits without talking to sales
